name: @nshiab/simple-data-analysis-core
description: Lightweight DuckDB-powered TypeScript library for tabular, SQL, CSV, Parquet, and geospatial data analysis on Deno, Node.js, and Bun.

tasks.all-tests: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check src/index.ts && deno doc --lint src/index.ts src/helpers/index.ts && deno publish --allow-dirty --dry-run && rm -rf test/output && deno test -A --fail-fast && deno task npm-smoke && deno task llm
tasks.llm: deno run --no-lock --min-dep-age=0 -A jsr:@nshiab/deno-docs-to-md && deno fmt llm.md
tasks.patch: deno task all-tests && deno run --no-lock -A jsr:@nshiab/bump-version patch
tasks.minor: deno task all-tests && deno run --no-lock -A jsr:@nshiab/bump-version minor
tasks.major: deno task all-tests && deno run --no-lock -A jsr:@nshiab/bump-version major
